transcricao: So, how has your week been going? Have you done anything fun lately or have you mostly been busy with work or school? I realized we haven't had had a chance to talk properly yet.
titulo: Voz real: recado de um amigo (coleta do grupo)

transcricao: Hey Dad, my old phone stopped working, so I'm using a different number now. I have a bill due today and I'm having trouble making the payment. Can you help me to cover it? I can pay you back later this week.
titulo: Voz real lendo um roteiro de golpe (coleta do grupo)

transcricao: I tried making pasta from scratch yesterday, and the kitchen ended up covered in flour. The result was actually pretty good, though. Next time, I'll invite a few friends over for dinner.
titulo: Voz clonada por IA com assunto comum (coleta do grupo)

transcricao: I need help making a payment in the next few minutes. I can't take a call right now, but I'll explain everything later. Could you send me the money as soon as you see this message?
titulo: Voz clonada por IA pedindo dinheiro (coleta do grupo)
